input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Substantively the Section 19 warranty package meets or exceeds our preferred position: §19.1 gives the professional/workmanlike and qualified-personnel standard plus an untimed conformity warranty; §19.2 gives 90 days for each Deliverable (custom work product under §1.4, matching our preferred services-side period) and term-long conformity for Hosted Services, which exceeds the 12-month software preference; §19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law and a no-malicious-code warranty; §19.4 supplies re-performance/repair/replacement plus termination and refund of Fees, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims; and §19.5 prevents the disclaimer from swallowing the express warranties. The single defect is drafting: the warranty period is spelled out in words only ("For ninety days"), with no numeral, which leaves the key parameter less certain than the rest of the Agreement's convention and risks argument over the measured period. The minimal redline inserts "(90)" so the period reads "ninety (90) days"; no substantive term is changed, and the malicious-code qualifier ("intentionally introduced by Vendor") remains an acceptable market-standard concession given the non-exclusive remedy stack.

proposal.summary: State the Deliverable warranty period as a numeral ("ninety (90) days") so the 90-day period is unambiguous.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added the numeral to the warranty period so it reads "ninety (90) days," consistent with how periods are expressed elsewhere in the Agreement. This is a drafting clarification only — the substance of the 90-day Deliverable warranty, the term-long Hosted Services conformity warranty and the Section 19.4 remedies are acceptable to us as drafted.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,
